gate_or_program: TYP-02 — Composition-Supported Typographic Role Grammar / Reflow
bounded_question: Can a responsive typographic role grammar add distinctive but subordinate Kymaean character and clearer hierarchy inside the compatible C0 + MAT F1 + STA F2 scaffold across APP/WEB, 320px, 200% text resize and text-spacing stress without requiring typography to carry identity alone?
controlled_inputs: CNEG plus F1-F4 system-ui mechanism-isolation families
APP/WEB at baseline 1200/320, 200% text resize, text-spacing stress and forced-colors
excluded_variables: real product semantics or production implementation

local_result.summary: F1 Ratio Ladder is the sole provisional role-grammar survivor. F2 Weight Plane, F3 Measure Plane and F4 Rhythm Plane fail frozen subjective criteria; CNEG is ineligible.

judgment.design_sol_view: F1 adds a materially clearer, restrained hierarchy inside the compatible packet scaffold while remaining subordinate to C0/MAT and coherent across APP/WEB and 320px. F2 reads as generic dashboard weight hierarchy; F3 depends on constrained measure/line breaks; F4 is too close to neutral/generic editorial rhythm.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: No separate Director taste gate is triggered because only one materially valid survivor remains. The result advances under standing clean-recursive-audit delegation and remains provisional/non-final.

visual: normal-baseline-wide and normal-baseline-320 frozen APP/WEB review surfaces
accessibility: zero horizontal document/text overflow in all eight modes
invalid_or_superseded_attempts: Run 34569839250 — shared-shell reflow fixture defect; no design result
Run 34570224341 — omitted pre-frozen shared wrap rule; no design result
Run 34570846103 — complete mechanical pass but generated preflight provenance metadata referenced Manifest 01; not canonical closure record

requires: fresh Phase-B sequencing/reentry audit before further integration/convergence
later final typeface work if/when authorized; F1 is role grammar only
constrains: future composition should preserve F1 Ratio Ladder role relationships as the provisional typography mechanism unless a bounded successor/refinement gate finds contrary evidence

known_integration_sensitivities: F1 was tested only with system-ui/Segoe UI measurement carrier; another typeface may alter perceived ratio and must be separately validated before production.
Real product density/content length may expose different hierarchy pressure than the low-density synthetic carriers.
CLR-01 remains parked and unresolved; color must not be used to retroactively justify TYP-02.
explicit_non_authority: No final typeface, custom font, bespoke glyph, wordmark/O3 change, CLR-01 selection, production token, app/site implementation, final identity or Phase-C convergence.
F1 is a provisional role-grammar mechanism, not an authorization to ship the system-ui fixture stack.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: F1 Ratio Ladder is the sole provisional survivor under frozen criteria; stress/forced modes are validation evidence, not aesthetic alternatives.
